sourceEntry: 2026-10-08 — Atlas layout and authenticated sharing (local source)
releaseSummary: Atlas saves page width, remembers sidebar width per signed-in user in the browser, keeps generated page/shared-link identifiers stable across title changes, and prepares an explicitly enabled read-only page link for any signed-in website account. Administrators can revoke sharing and inspect account/page/version/time access. Migration and frontend publication are pending approval; no production write.

moduleImpact.notes: Updated as part of Atlas layout and authenticated sharing (local source).

migrationNotes: No manual data migration is required for this release.
